correctness.rationale: For m>=1, t_i>=2, k>=4 and r=k-1, the induced independent-set formulas are alpha(S)=sum_i max(ell_i,q_i) and alpha(S+hub)=max(alpha(S),1+sum_i q_i). The hub-matching pairs all faces with fewer than r selected private vertices, leaving exactly r selected private vertices and at most one leaf from each corresponding block. Distinguished-leaf matching is acyclic on the product of coordinate stars and leaves one (2r-1)-cell for each choice of r blocks and non-basepoint leaves, plus a critical vertex; hence the claimed integral wedge and binomial weighted multiplicity. Separately the relative chains C_*(A,L) decompose as tensor products of augmentation complexes Z[L_i]->Z, giving the canonical integral free top homology module and character sum. Swapping two two-vertex block pieces has even permutation sign, so no extra tensor-swap sign. For r>m the top group vanishes and the complex contracts. The complete attached verify.py independently computes induced independent numbers via a generic recurrence, full finite Hasse graph acyclicity and signed Lefschetz traces in 21 small cases and 24 automorphism comparisons; these finite checks are not used as the universal proof.
